_doc: The declared estate: which repositories, public surfaces and package registries the nightly estate-health snapshot measures. This file is the ONLY place the estate is enumerated — scripts/estate-health.mjs holds no repository names. Provenance follows scripts/generate-release-manifest.sh: 'first-party' is written here, 'imported' is a fork or vendored upstream. Adding a repository to the estate means adding a row here; the collector, the page and the dream evaluator all follow. Output order is roster order, so this file also fixes the display order of the published snapshot.
